answer.reason: The verses only list Javan among the sons of Japheth and name his sons, which the summary already states, and the Ezekiel verse names Javan as a trading people of Tyre, not the son of Japheth.
doubts: EZK 27:13 likely refers to the people or land of Javan trading with Tyre, not the man himself, so it was left out.
